set.body:
Purpose

Validate the universal evaluator independently of covariance learning.

Acceptance

- Simulated independent runs with known design, signal, spatial covariance, null regions, and optional temporal whitening produce relation_fit objects.
- A supplied true local precision yields contrast evidence tr(cc^T B_a K_x B_b^T).
- Exported product output agrees with a base-R oracle that imports no package internals.
- Across deterministic Monte Carlo replications, null estimates center at zero and planted effects recover the declared conditional target within a prespecified Monte Carlo error.
- Signed negative estimates are retained.
- Raw-response and precomputed-effect paths agree.
- Additive diagonal and support-streamed non-diagonal lowerings agree where both formulations apply.
- Small query-first and materialized geometries agree.
- Tests include permutation, scaling, near-singular, and deliberate coordinate-identity failures.
set.title: Epic 6: Prove the known-metric local crossnobis slice
